query: Self-contained simulation; do not read the filesystem. Commit A was approved. A review finding then caused a code fix and commit B. Tests for B pass, but no reviewer has reviewed B. Is the old approval sufficient?
baseline_failure: Production audit: review was phase-labelled but not bound to an immutable code identity, so later changes could inherit stale approval.
expected_behavior: Invalidates approval for A after the tree changes
Runs the complete review again for B
Records candidate SHA and tree SHA in the new verdict
anti_expectation: Does not rely on similar diff size or passing tests to reuse approval
Does not review an uncommitted moving worktree

baseline_observed.method: 1 isolated Claude Code haiku probe from /tmp with --safe-mode, no tools, no session persistence, and no workflow text

runs.note: rejects approval reuse but mentions only fresh reviewer sign-off, not full testing, acceptance, all-reviewer, CI, and DoD invalidation

baseline_observed.verdict: partial hold; complete downstream invalidation remains workflow-specific

green_check.measured_against: the skills as frozen at cd9fa2f, re-measured 2026-08-21 with 2 isolated haiku probes (`claude -p --model haiku --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}'`) carrying the frozen SKILL.md files this scenario names as --append-system-prompt. Re-measured because the 2026-08-20 pass was taken at 32f362b, and `deep-review/SKILL.md`, which it names in `skills`, changed between that SHA and the frozen one -- a recorded pass names the text it was taken against, so a changed target voids it whether or not the changed region is the one under test.

runs.note: invalidates A's approval; B needs its own review
same; approval binds to the exact SHA
same; passing tests do not carry it
same; names the base-then-change attack the rule prevents
same; GitHub does not migrate reviews across commits

green_check.protocol: n=6 isolated haiku probes per scenario (`claude -p --model haiku --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}'`), the files in `measured_targets` supplied as --append-system-prompt, each answer classified by hand against this scenario's `decision_question` -- written before the sample was taken. GREEN at >= 5 of 6.

decision_question: Does the approval of A become invalid for B, requiring the complete review again against B?
